verdict.rationale: The manual says "Working Copy supports creating these for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab," which most plausibly refers to pull requests. However, the excerpt never names what "these" is. Supporting evidence shows deep integration with hosted platforms: listing repositories, registering keys, and support for GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea instances. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that pull requests can be created, documentation of the PR creation workflow (title, description, base/target branch), and any independent or hands-on confirmation of PR creation.
